Private Function Describe(c As Object) As String
    Dim v As Object
    Set v = c.Validation
    Describe = R_Type(v) & "~;~" & R_AlertStyle(v) & "~;~" & R_Operator(v) & "~;~" & R_Formula1(v) & "~;~" & R_Formula2(v) & "~;~" & R_IgnoreBlank(v) & "~;~" & R_InCellDropdown(v) & "~;~" & R_ShowInput(v) & "~;~" & R_ShowError(v) & "~;~" & R_InputTitle(v) & "~;~" & R_InputMessage(v) & "~;~" & R_ErrorTitle(v) & "~;~" & R_ErrorMessage(v) & "~;~" & R_Value(v)
End Function
